definitions.gloss: organization; systematization; structuring into a system
definitions.explanation: The process of arranging people, activities, or information into a structured, organized system. Also refers to forming or unifying a group into an organized body.

examples.japanese: ⟦{労働者|ろうどうしゃ}→労働者：23971_roudousha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{組織化|そしきか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んだ→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{組織化|そしきか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧⟦{効率|こうりつ}→効率：11794_kouritsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧。

⟦ボランティア→ボランティア：04834_borantia⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{組織化|そしきか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ことで、より⟦{効果的|こうかてき}→効果的：04793_koukateki⟧な⟦{支援|しえん}→支援：07778_shien⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{可能|かのう}→可能：00175_kanou⟧になった。
examples.english: By organizing volunteer activities, more effective support became possible.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{組織|そしき}→組織：03320_soshiki⟧ (organization) and ⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ (the suffix meaning "-ization, turning into"). Describes the process of bringing order and structure to something that was previously unstructured.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {組織化|そしきか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to organize, to systematize
- {組織化|そしきか}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧: organized, structured
- {組織化|そしきか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧: organization progresses
- {組織化|そしきか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{図|はか}る→図る：12006_hakaru⟧: to aim for organization

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {体系化|たいけいか}: systematization — emphasizes creating a logical system or framework
- {制度化|せいどか}: institutionalization — making something into an official system or institution
- ⟦{組織|そしき}→組織：03320_soshiki⟧: organization — the result (a structured body), not the process of creating one
